changes.before:
Claude Bernard received his master's degree from Lyon 1 University in Lyon, France. During his studies, he completed a research internship at the Institute of Molecular and Supramolecular Chemistry and Biochemistry and Wayne State University in Michigan, USA. In 2016–2021, he received a PhD degree in "Synthesis of therapeutic nanomaterials" at the University of Quebec in Canada.

Since 2022, he has been working as a postdoctoral researcher at Georgia State University, USA.

He is the author of 10 scientific articles published in high-impact international journals. His h-index is 4 according to the Scopus database.

His scientific activity includes the bioactive chemical synthesis of carbohydrate molecules. In particular, he published articles on the effective synthesis of di- and trisaccharides used in cancer diagnostics in the journals "Carbohydrate Research" and "International Journal of Molecular Science." Nadir has developed a new and effective synthesis of Migalastat, a drug used for Fabry disease, and plans to apply for a patent for this methodology.
